text:
Ivy Patel: Hey everyone 44b! First day on Data Platform. Laptop all set but I'm missing access to the secrets repo and Key Vault UI shows 'access denied'. Also curious about team lunches — any traditions? :bento:

Nora Lopez: welcome Ivy! I'm your onboarding buddy. For Key Vault ping @IT Support and I'll add you to the secrets-review channel. Team lunch is usually a rotating chef week, but we order on Wed/Thu.

IT Support: Hi Ivy 4bb can you run `az account show --output json` and confirm the subscription email (redwood account only)? We'll check Key Vault ACLs.

Ivy Patel: "user": "ivy.patel@redwood.com" in the output. Thanks, running the command now.

Onboard Bot: New hire Ivy Patel added. Checklist: sso_provisioned: true, keyvault_access: false, repo_access: pending, slack_invite: true.

IT Support: Thanks. You weren't in the 'secrets-consumers' group. Added now. It may take a few minutes to propagate. Try the Key Vault UI again in ~5 minutes or run `az keyvault secret list --vault-name prod-secrets` to check via CLI.

Ivy Patel: tried the CLI and now I can list secrets 44d. Repo invite still pending though.

Samir Patel: pinged the repo owners for the secrets-repo invite. Also FYI we do a quick 5-min show-and-tell Friday — bring a weird hobby or a favorite terminal trick.

Maya Lin: Ivy, when you have a sec, please fill out the hardware form and request standing desk if you'd like: https://redwood.inference/onboard/hardware.

Ivy Patel: Will do. Fun fact: I collect novelty hiking socks from every state I visit 64c3c4 — happy to show the collection on Friday!

HR Bot: Welcome Ivy! Orientation at 9:30 in #all-hands. Please complete payroll & benefits forms: https://redwood.inference/hr/forms.

Nora Lopez: great! I'll add Ivy to the weekly sync and drop a calendar invite for our 1:1 at 3pm. Lunch plan: try the new dosa place tomorrow?

Ivy Patel: Dosa sounds amazing 60b. Thanks for the warm welcome, everyone!
